agent_note: Clean third-person past narration centred on Emira, with Alix/Alex, Briar and Kelley as recurring figures. Event yield is high (14 of 25) and unanimously past — no present-tense narration survives once dialogue is separated out, which is the near-unfakeable evidence pattern METHODOLOGY describes for past. Unusually low gnomic contamination for this source: only 1 of 25. Quotation marks survive on 5 quotes (some degraded to single apostrophes by the scrape), so the remaining dialogue was assigned from direct address, vocative-free second person, imperatives, and colloquial spoken register. Several quotes mix speech and narration and were resolved by word-count on the quotation-mark majority rule: q04570, q04572 and q04573 fall clearly to event; q04575 is a 20-to-19 near-tie awarded to dialogue and is the one genuine flip risk, though flipping it would only add another past event quote. Every present-tense verb in the set sits inside speech, free direct thought, an embedded generalization (q04574), or the abstained fragment q04577.
